notes: Car F — multi-profile full isolation (design section 13.1). (1) Path seam: a new dependency-free module resolves every product path from the environment — AIDOG_PROFILE selects a named profile under profiles/<name>/ (settings.json, secrets.env, state/ for sessions/cron/evolution/checkpoints, body/ for SOUL/memory/learned skills/evolution, images/), while an unset variable keeps byte-identical legacy paths (zero migration, every pre-existing suite stayed green untouched). An invalid profile name raises ProfileError and the launcher exits rc=5 — a typo can never fall through to another profile's runtime. Precedence everywhere: AIDOG_MC_STATE > profile state > repo default; shared read-only layer stays overlay/locales + shipped overlay/skills + the seed templates. (2) Every mycore settings/secrets/state/body read site and the console constants (SECRETS/SETTINGS_FILE/MEDIA_DIR/state dir) now resolve through the seam; /api/status gained a `profile` field and the console header shows the active profile name when set. (3) Operations: `aidog profile list|create|rm` (create seeds settings byte-copy, an empty-slot secrets file with exactly three keys, SOUL/memory copies from the overlay templates, and writes profile.json last; rm refuses running-state profiles without --force and never escapes profiles/), plus deploy/profile_ctl.sh start|stop|status <name> managing tmux aidog_svc_<name> and aidog_web_<name> (health probe asserts /api/health status==ok). run_service.sh reads the profile's own secrets and exports its own state; fail-closed semantics kept (rc 3/4 empty slots, rc 5 bad name). (4) Verification: a new offline gate tests/profile_f.py with 63 checks — path-seam units, a subprocess dual-profile crosstalk probe (two real ChatService processes, each running /learn, /cron, /reflect and a chat turn, asserting zero bytes cross profiles and a byte-identical default layer), stack/skill-root isolation, CLI seeding and launcher semantics — plus a real-machine E2E with 18 checks (default console smoke, profile create, an isolated profile console reading and writing its own settings on a separate port while the default console stays untouched, fail-closed service legs, byte-identical default layer end to end); a second profile's live Telegram dialogue is honestly marked pending a second bot. Suites: core 981/981, console smoke 146/146, router 30/30, memory 58/58, setup 99/99, profile isolation 63/63, desktop 15/15, doctor 0F/0W, publish READY(0), locale packs 285/285 unchanged. Honest boundaries kept: watchdog/setup/doctor still supervise the default profile only, deploy scripts resolve profiles/ under the repo (AIDOG_PROFILES_DIR is a library-level seam for tests), and this is one machine with isolated profiles — not hosted multi-tenancy or a role system.
